    - Show delete button when task is selected (not root)
  - System confirms the intent
    - Compute recursive descendant count for selected task
    - Leaves (0 descendants) require only the initial click
    - Tasks with descendants require N additional clicks (N = descendant count)

    - Cancel confirmation on Escape or selecting a different task
  - System deletes the task
    - Expose DELETE /tasks/:id endpoint

    - Persist updated tree
  - Tree re-renders after deletion

  - A task has empty description by default

      - guardar show ids

  - airear para volver a la vista natural actual

  - unificar menú para árboles
